notes: SmolLM3-3B_q4_block32_ekv4096.litertlm as uploaded to litert-community/SmolLM3-3B on 2026-10-06 (Hub commit af261561): graph rewrite of the previous Hub file (KV-cache writes -> odml.cache_update, attention products -> odml.runtime_bmm, param_tensor input, broadcast mask add) plus one copied 16-token prefill signature; the weights are byte-identical to the previous file (sha256 119fc1f266c4...), which this upload replaced. Built and measured by the litertlm-convert GPU graph re-ship lane (rounds 1-21). Mac gate of this file (round 19, litertlm-convert gpu_reship_work/results/ship_verify): 6/6 points — weights and every other section byte-identical to the previous file, tflite CPU outputs bit-identical, litert-lm CPU answers 9/9 byte-identical, GPU (WebGPU) fully delegated with fp32 activations 9/9 byte-identical; GPU fp16 (the default) final answers 7/8 against 6/8 without the 16-token signature. Galaxy S26 GPU gate (round 16, Session path, greedy): 4/4 questions, long prompt correct, the same points as the file without the 16-token signature on the same phone (that gate ran the earlier subgraph order of the same graph; the shipped order answers byte-identically on the Mac, round 19). Previous file on the same Mac in the same lock window (litert-lm 0.17.1, same flags): gpu p256 d256: decode 90.48 tok/s, prefill 1343.66 tok/s, TTFT 0.2055 s; gpu p16 d32: decode 86.68 tok/s, prefill 166.1 tok/s, TTFT 0.1108 s; cpu p256 d256: decode 24.77 tok/s, prefill 139.32 tok/s, TTFT 2.27 s; cpu p16 d32: decode 19.19 tok/s, prefill 17.7 tok/s, TTFT 1.3249 s. iPhone 18 Pro: CPU answers of this file 9/9 byte-identical to the file without the 16-token signature on the same phone (round 21, 8 questions + a long prompt); the Metal gate of this file ran in round 15.
quantization: int4 weights - blockwise (block 32) + OCTAV optimal-clipping, symmetric; embedding INT8
